title: The Prisoner
author: Daniel El Fuego
description: Escape a dark cell before your captors return.

sections.text: You wake up in what seems to be a dark prison cell, on an old wooden bed. Metal bars are preventing you to escape from the room. There is no window.
The door is locked, but as you feel around the lock, you notice something jammed inside it - a rusty key.

options.description: Pull out the key and use it

sections.text: You don't see anything, it's too dark.

options.description: Try to scan the area with your hands

consequence.text: As you move your hands left and right under the bed, you cut yourself on a rusty nail.

sections.text: Your fingers brush against a small metal object - it's a key.

options.description: Grab the key and try the door

consequence.text: You slice your palm open on broken glass hidden in the dark.

sections.text: The door creaks open. A dim corridor stretches ahead, guarded by a sleeping sentry.
Your hand is bleeding badly now. You feel dizzy.

options.description: Press on and open the door anyway

sections.text: You slip past silently and escape into the night. Freedom at last!
